knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson requires factual nonconformance descriptions and reinspection of the same criterion after correction. Acknowledgement is not verification.
The worked example isolates the slippery residue, removes it by the approved method and verifies the floor before closing the defect.
The detailed method says to describe each nonconformance factually: location, expected criterion, observed condition, risk and evidence.

practicalCriteria: Closes only verified corrections, escalates unresolved hazards and maintains a traceable defect history.
Uses the authorised work order and site instructions
Recognises and escalates hazards or scope limitations
Records objective evidence and correction where needed
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 7: Record the result as pass, unresolved limitation or escalation, and keep a traceable defect history.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 2 is not done: Prioritise safety hazards, and stop any unsafe work first.
Stop work if procedure step 3 is not done: Confirm the work scope, the hazards, material or equipment suitability, and who can authorise changes.
Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Record the result as pass, unresolved limitation or escalation, and keep a traceable defect history.
